claim: INFERRED: those defaults create a fresh signal per parent render, so prop equality never holds.
actual: The default is evaluated in the generated builder's build() (dioxus-core-macro 0.7.10 props/mod.rs:1433-1439, inside with_owner of the props owner), so a signal is allocated per props construction. But fields typed ReadSignal are excluded from PartialEq: memoize_impl compares the peeked values, calls point_to on the old signal and only marks dirty if the values differ (props/mod.rs:661-675). So 'prop equality never holds' is false; the cost is one allocation per render, not forced child re-renders.
